# Sysinternals MCP

FastMCP 3.4 wrapper for 12 Sysinternals CLI tools.

**Full detail: see [llms-full.txt](llms-full.txt)**

---

## Quick links

- [README.md](README.md) -- overview and quick start
- [INSTALL.md](INSTALL.md) -- install, IDE snippets
- [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md) -- release notes

---

## Tools

| Tool | Entry point | Output format |
|------|-------------|---------------|
| autorunsc | `run_autorunsc()` | CSV |
| handle64 | `list_handles()` | Parsed text |
| pslist | `list_processes()` | Fixed-width |
| listdlls | `list_all_dlls()` | Multi-section |
| tcpvcon | `list_connections()` | CSV |
| sigcheck | `run_sigcheck()` | CSV |
| accesschk | `check_permissions()` | Line-oriented |
| psloggedon | `list_logged_on_users()` | Fixed-width |
| psfile | `list_remote_files()` | Line-oriented |
| coreinfo | `get_cpu_info()` | Labeled sections |
| du | `disk_usage()` | Line-oriented |
| psinfo | `system_info()` | Labeled sections |

---

## Ports

| Service | Port |
|---------|------|
| MCP HTTP transport | 11074 |

---

## Run

```powershell
uv sync --group dev
uv run sysinternals-mcp
```
